policy: security/headers.json - the canonical HTTP response headers for every deployment of this bundle

consumers.vercel.json: carries exactly the site headers marked in_vercel (checked by security/test.mjs); the others are open there
consumers.cloudflare/_headers: generated by cloudflare/build.py from this file: every site header on /* (checked by cloudflare/test.mjs). Its /api/* block is kept for static paths only: Cloudflare Pages does not apply _headers to Pages Functions responses
consumers.payments/worker.mjs: the api headers are set by the Worker itself on every /api/* reply, copied from this file by payments/build.py (checked by payments/test.mjs)

site.why: a response is only ever the type it declares
a learner's page path never leaves this origin in a Referer
baseline: no framing (clickjacking), no <base> hijack, no plugins, forms post only here. Restricts nothing the pages load, so it cannot break their inline scripts

api.why: the API returns JSON only; nothing in a response may load or be framed

open: A script-src/style-src CSP: every page carries inline scripts and styles, so it needs per-page sha256 hashes computed at build time before it can be switched on.
vercel.json does not yet carry the baseline Content-Security-Policy (in_vercel false); adding it is a deploy change for the maintainers.
Strict-Transport-Security: set by the host's TLS configuration once a domain exists; no domain is configured here.
